# Mayo Clinic

> Mayo Clinic is a nonprofit academic medical center offering patient care, health information, research, education, and digital health programs.

Mayo Clinic provides care across hospitals and clinics, publishes extensive disease and wellness guidance, and supports patients, professionals, researchers, and learners through clinical services, medical education, and research resources.

## Patient Care
- [Patient Care & Health Information](https://www.mayoclinic.org/patient-care-and-health-information): Main gateway to clinical care, specialties, conditions, and patient resources.
- [Departments & Centers](https://www.mayoclinic.org/departments-centers): Browse Mayo Clinic medical departments, specialty centers, and clinical programs.
- [Doctors & Medical Staff](https://www.mayoclinic.org/biographies): Directory of Mayo Clinic physicians, scientists, and medical staff biographies.
- [Appointments](https://www.mayoclinic.org/appointments): Information for requesting appointments and becoming a Mayo Clinic patient.
- [International Services](https://www.mayoclinic.org/departments-centers/international): Resources for international patients seeking Mayo Clinic care.
- [Locations](https://www.mayoclinic.org/patient-visitor-guide/minnesota): Entry point to campus and visitor information for Mayo Clinic locations.

## Diseases & Conditions
- [Diseases & Conditions A-Z](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/index): Alphabetical index of diseases, conditions, symptoms, and treatment overviews.
- [Symptoms A-Z](https://www.mayoclinic.org/symptoms/index): Symptom-based health information with causes and care guidance.
- [Tests & Procedures A-Z](https://www.mayoclinic.org/tests-procedures/index): Explanations of diagnostic tests, surgeries, and medical procedures.
- [Drugs & Supplements A-Z](https://www.mayoclinic.org/drugs-supplements/index): Reference information for medications, supplements, and proper use.
- [Healthy Lifestyle](https://www.mayoclinic.org/healthy-lifestyle): Preventive health, fitness, nutrition, and wellness guidance.
- [First Aid](https://www.mayoclinic.org/first-aid): Emergency and first-aid instructions for common injuries and urgent situations.

## Care at Mayo Clinic
- [Arizona](https://www.mayoclinic.org/patient-visitor-guide/arizona): Patient and visitor guide for Mayo Clinic in Arizona.
- [Florida](https://www.mayoclinic.org/patient-visitor-guide/florida): Patient and visitor guide for Mayo Clinic in Florida.
- [Minnesota](https://www.mayoclinic.org/patient-visitor-guide/minnesota): Patient and visitor guide for Mayo Clinic in Minnesota.
- [Mayo Clinic Health System](https://www.mayoclinichealthsystem.org): Regional care network with clinics, hospitals, and local services.
- [Patient & Visitor Guide](https://www.mayoclinic.org/patient-visitor-guide): Planning information for travel, lodging, and campus visits.
- [Billing & Insurance](https://www.mayoclinic.org/billing-insurance): Billing, insurance, and financial information for patients and families.

## Research
- [Research](https://www.mayo.edu/research): Overview of Mayo Clinic research programs, institutes, and scientific initiatives.
- [Centers & Programs](https://www.mayo.edu/research/centers-programs): Research centers, cores, and collaborative scientific programs.
- [Clinical Trials](https://www.mayo.edu/research/clinical-trials): Search and learn about Mayo Clinic clinical research studies.
- [Research Faculty](https://www.mayo.edu/research/faculty): Directory of principal investigators and research faculty profiles.
- [Labs](https://www.mayo.edu/research/labs): Browse Mayo Clinic research laboratories and areas of investigation.
- [Research Services](https://www.mayo.edu/research/services): Shared resources, technology platforms, and support services for researchers.

## Education
- [Mayo Clinic College of Medicine and Science](https://college.mayo.edu): Hub for Mayo Clinic medical education and training programs.
- [Medical School](https://college.mayo.edu/academics/mayo-clinic-alix-school-of-medicine): Information about Mayo Clinic Alix School of Medicine.
- [Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences](https://college.mayo.edu/academics/graduate-school-of-biomedical-sciences): Graduate biomedical science degrees and research training programs.
- [School of Health Sciences](https://college.mayo.edu/academics/school-of-health-sciences): Allied health education, certificates, and professional training programs.
- [School of Graduate Medical Education](https://college.mayo.edu/academics/school-of-graduate-medical-education): Residency and fellowship training across specialties.
- [Continuing Medical Education](https://ce.mayo.edu): Continuing education courses, conferences, and CME opportunities.

## For Medical Professionals
- [Medical Professionals](https://www.mayoclinic.org/medical-professionals): Resources for referring physicians and healthcare professionals.
- [Provider Relations](https://www.mayoclinic.org/medical-professionals/provider-relations): Referral support and collaboration resources for external providers.
- [Medical Laboratories](https://www.mayocliniclabs.com): Diagnostic laboratory testing services and test catalog for professionals.
- [Mayo Clinic Proceedings](https://www.mayoclinicproceedings.org): Peer-reviewed medical journal with clinical and research articles.
- [CME Courses](https://ce.mayo.edu): Accredited continuing education for clinicians and healthcare teams.
- [Clinical Updates](https://www.mayoclinic.org/medical-professionals/clinical-updates): News and updates relevant to medical practice and referrals.

## News & Publications
- [News Network](https://newsnetwork.mayoclinic.org): Official Mayo Clinic news, press releases, and expert stories.
- [Mayo Clinic Press](https://mcpress.mayoclinic.org): Consumer health articles, books, and evidence-based wellness content.
- [Mayo Clinic Proceedings](https://www.mayoclinicproceedings.org): Scholarly journal publishing clinical reviews, research, and commentary.
- [Sharing Mayo Clinic](https://sharing.mayoclinic.org): Patient stories, community voices, and experiences with care.
- [Mayo Clinic Minute](https://newsnetwork.mayoclinic.org/category/mayo-clinic-minute): Short health news segments and expert video updates.
- [Media Contacts](https://newsnetwork.mayoclinic.org/media-contacts): Press contact information for journalists and media inquiries.

## Giving & Organization
- [About Mayo Clinic](https://www.mayoclinic.org/about-mayo-clinic): Overview of Mayo Clinic’s mission, values, and organization.
- [Mayo Clinic Platform](https://www.mayoclinic.org/about-mayo-clinic/mayo-clinic-platform): Digital health and data platform initiatives at Mayo Clinic.
- [Philanthropy](https://philanthropy.mayoclinic.org): Giving opportunities and donor-supported Mayo Clinic initiatives.
- [Careers](https://jobs.mayoclinic.org): Employment opportunities across clinical, research, and administrative roles.
- [Executive Leadership](https://www.mayoclinic.org/about-mayo-clinic/governance): Governance and leadership information for the organization.
- [Contact Mayo Clinic](https://www.mayoclinic.org/about-mayo-clinic/contact): General contact information and support resources.

## Digital Health Programs
- [Mayo Clinic Diet](https://diet.mayoclinic.org): Digital weight management program with meal plans and habit coaching.
- [Meal Plans](https://diet.mayoclinic.org/us/meal-plans): Structured meal plans and dietary approaches within Mayo Clinic Diet.
- [Anxiety Coach](https://anxietycoach.mayoclinic.org): Digital tools and guidance for anxiety, OCD, and exposure practice.
- [Family Stress Resource Center](https://anxietycoach.mayoclinic.org/family-stress): Resources to help families and children manage stress and change.
- [Doing Exposures](https://anxietycoach.mayoclinic.org/anxiety/doing-exposures): Practical guide to exposure exercises for anxiety treatment support.
- [Cancer Education](https://cancereducation.mayoclinic.org): Educational support for living with cancer and managing side effects.
